# WEB-Synth vendoring notes

Temporaman changes the title and visible branding, adds a graphical monophonic piano roll, limits recordings to 60 seconds, and adds an authenticated **Send to Audacity** action for the most recently rendered WAV. Sending uploads directly to the shared imports folder without also downloading the WAV to the browser device.
